probe.text_sample: GIOLABS / Immersive Experiences Tickets Tickets Book your ticket Book your ticket Dinosaurs are back. Dinosaurs are back. And this time you walk among them Discover more Discover more First Digital Art Center in Luxembourg The immersive experience destination at GRIDX. GIOLABS is the immersive experience destination at GRIDX, a digital art center in Luxembourg where shows and events become experiences you step inside. No screens to watch from a distance. You’re in the middle of it. You’ll find it inside GRIDX in Wickrange, about 15 minutes from Luxembourg City. Two shows are on now: Dinosaurs, a prehistoric world made for families, and I See Music, where sound becomes light and colour. Open every day except Mondays and Wednesdays, tickets from €9, free parking on site. What's on at GIOLABS 4+ Dinosaurs are back Walk through forests that breathe, oceans that move, and giants that tower over you. A prehistoric world brought to life around you. Made for families, thrilling at any age.
